elon_tickets.title: Web Search Integration (Google)
elon_tickets.what: Integrate Google Search directly into Thunderbird OS for comprehensive web information retrieval.
elon_tickets.why: Enhance core search functionality with direct integration of a leading search engine.
elon_tickets.how: Implement a new module in `src/core/search/integrations/google_search.ts` that utilizes the Google Search API. This will involve creating a `GoogleSearchProvider` class with a `search(query: string): Promise<SearchResult[]>` method, referencing `src/core/search/search_manager.ts` for integration.
elon_tickets.elon_note: Because apparently, our existing search is just a glorified calculator. Let's summon the all-knowing Google.

a5_ratings.note: Directly integrating a single external search engine bypasses our opportunity to build a novel, horizontal AI search pattern for the platform.

a9_checks.new_cost: YES + $15/month (Google Custom Search API Standard Plan)
a9_checks.roi: Enhanced core search functionality, improved user experience, potential for increased client engagement and retention by providing more comprehensive information access.
